levels.surface: أحمد بن حفص بن عبد الله

notes: «قال حدثني أبي» names Ahmad's father only as «أبي»: relation (rule 7)
«- هو ابن طهمان -» is an editor's gloss and is left out
The Prophet is the end of the chain; the last link is Abu Sa'id

fixes.reason: K6I puts a name in the place the text fills with bare «أبي»; the text names no one there.

evidence.quote: حفص بن عبد الله بن راشد
